unsuccessful_checks.result: Failed during implementation; format/field initialization, unused legacy helpers and lint issues were corrected before final checks.
779 passed, three read-only adapter-provider tests failed, ten ignored; required provider access resolved the environment restriction. Final ordinary suite passed 784.
Vite/esbuild could not read the parent directory; the elevated build pipeline passed contracts and Vite.
Hook functions appeared before plugin registration and template constants; compilation failed. Include ordering was corrected and checked.
Direct abort callbacks conflicted with MUI callbacks; compilation failed. Fixed MUI custom abort hooks are used.
Succeeded with an already-patched bundle-marker warning. The final fresh build succeeded without that warning.
Pinned NSIS preprocessing skipped the added plugin registration and could not resolve Tauri plugin calls. Generated source plus real compiler trace with MUI logging are checked instead.
Compilation succeeded; default MUI logging hid generated abort callback bodies. MUI_VERBOSE=4 exposes the callbacks and final contract passes.

A byte-equality assumption failed: packaged NSS and staged UNK bundle markers differ by exactly three bytes. The pinned tauri-utils mapping and all remaining bytes were verified, and both hashes are recorded.
